MADial-Bench Towards real-world evaluation of memory-augmented diglogue generation

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark for memory-augmented dialogue generation (NAACL per repo): 160 dialogues and 171 dated event memories with time, emotion and scene. Tasks are memory retrieval and memory recognition/response, with passive and proactive (emotion- or scene-triggered) recall.
